Added: Introducing the Winners Circle! After a free-for-all One Gun or All Gun match, the celebration fades in on third place, swishes to second, circles the champion, and finishes with a Trophy-drop hero moment set to an original arcade-rock ceremony cue.
Podium winners appear with their chosen character, color, and equipped Victory Move. All three can celebrate together while the final standings are revealed.
Official Classic champions now receive a special Trophy-drop celebration in front of first place.
Every player gets a personal results card with their placement, round wins, kills, disarms, and reward preview.
Check the complete match standings, mark yourself Ready when you are finished, or let the host return everyone to the lobby.
Account & Store is now available from the main menu! Create an account, sign in, view your Gun Tokens, browse the shop, check owned items, and equip cosmetics.
Your equipped character skin, hat, accessory, gun skin, melee skin, and Victory Move now travel with you into online lobbies and matches.
A new Female character joins Character Customization with all 13 colors and their matching portraits.

Online chat is now available in lobbies, the Playpen, matches, and spectator mode. Messages appear as quick notifications and speech bubbles above players. Press T to open chat window and Enter to start typing!
A new red damage indicator shows the direction of incoming gunfire.
All six powerups now have unique pixel-art pickup icons.
Improved: Default One Gun and All Gun matches now use three-minute rounds, three round wins per set, and one set to win the match.
New Low, Medium, High, and Ultra quality tuning improves performance across gameplay, menus, map previews, effects, and the Winners Circle.
A new Ceremony Volume setting lets you tune Winners Circle celebrations separately from music and sound effects.
Winners Circle placements now use match performance to produce consistent final standings.
Chat messages stay separated between the lobby, Playpen, and active match so each conversation remains in the right place.
Cosmetics with unfinished artwork can still be owned and equipped safely while their final visuals are being prepared.
Fixed: Accounts without a loaded username now show CLOUD PROFILE instead of Signed In Null.
Typing in chat no longer moves your character or spectator camera.
Female character colors, portraits, animations, equipment, and online appearances now display consistently.
Disconnected players no longer prevent everyone else from finishing the Winners Circle Ready check.
Removed: Vampire Touch has been removed from powerup drops, match settings, saved presets, and the Playpen.
Misc: During this test, post-match Trophy, XP, and Gun Token rewards are previews only and are not saved to your account yet.
Shop items marked ART PENDING are ready in the account system but do not have their final in-game appearance yet.
The Winners Circle currently supports free-for-all One Gun and All Gun. Team matches and One of Us still use the previous match-ending screen.
